_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Equipment Structureborne Vibratory Acceleration Measurement Plan
summary: This plan provides a description of the structureborne sound test procedure, facility and measurement system in advance of test to demonstrate planned compliance with requirements of MIL-STD-740-2.
description_purpose: This plan provides a description of the structureborne sound test procedure, facility and measurement system in advance of test to demonstrate planned compliance with requirements of MIL-STD-740-2.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for that data generated under the work task described by 4.2 of MIL-STD-740-2.
This DID may be applied for each type, class, rating, and grade of equipment to be measured on each contract or order when MIL-STD-740-2 is invoked.
The data generated under the requirements of this DID may be combined with the data generated under DI-HFAC-80270 associated with MIL-STD-740-1.
This DID supersedes UDI-T-23756.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: General test plan requirements.
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall contain the following information:

children.title: Test and equipment information.
Equipment to be evaluated, including contract number.
Ship names and hull number, if known, for which the unit is being acquired.
Evaluation measurements to be performed.
Evaluating activity and test site.
Test date if established.
Equipment specification acceptance criteria.
Driven and driver unit manufacturers.
Driver unit horsepower (HP).
Rated electrical characteristics, including volts, amperes, phase.
Rated fluid media parameters (flow rates, temperatures, pressures, etc.)
Equipment rated operational speeds (driver and driven unit revolutions per minute (r/min), etc.)
Expected equipment noise and vibration sources and their frequencies of excitation (rotationals, gear tooth contact, blade rate, etc.).
Resilient mount manufacturer and model number.
Dates of manufacture of resilient mounts to be used.
Number of resilient mounts to be used.
If the use of non-Navy standard resilient mounts has been approved, provide the characteristics including load rating in pounds and resonant frequency data, of the mounts used.
Planned equipment load during test (full, half, etc.).
Planned operating speeds during test.
Planned throttling conditions, if any.
Planned operating suction and discharge fluid media parameters during test (flow rates, pressures and temperatures, etc.).
Planned electrical inputs, outputs or both during test.
Block diagrams and identification of make and model of measurement and analysis instrumentation to be used.
Block diagrams and identification of make and model of system calibration instrumentation to be used.
Place and date of latest laboratory calibration of measurement instruments, system calibration instruments (including field calibrators), and analysis instruments which will be used.
Drawings and sketches to show assembly information, equipment details and the test set up.
Overall unit dimensions and orientation (vertical, horizontal, etc.) to be used during test.
Identification of major components.
Interface information.
Mounting locations and dimensions.
Weights and center of gravity for major components.
Resilient mount orientation (vertical, horizontal, angle), approximate load on each mount, attachment locations, overall unit weight and center of gravity.
Pedestal or subbase dimensions, materials and weight, when applicable.
Dimensions, materials, and weight of the mounting fixture if a mounting fixture other than the standard fixture is to be used.
Planned arrangement and description of flexible pipes and ducts, if to be used.
Planned arrangement of test piping and fittings.
Planned arrangement of electrical power leads.
Planned location and description of test instrumentation used to measure r/min, flow rates, total discharge head, etc.
Planned locations of resilient mounts and pedestals or fixtures that support the equipment.
Approximate location and orientation of each accelerometer relative to equipment features or mounts and method of attachment of accelerometers.
Test data formats.
Tabular and graphic data format to be used in tabulating and recording structureborne vibratory acceleration data.
